decisions.reason: Correctly attributes failure to fs-ext@2.1.1 install script (node-gyp configure build) as a pinned dependency of dsh-session-persistence-jsonl, with missing Visual Studio/MSVC toolchain as the cause.
Explains the static top-level flock import forces fs-ext to load even on Windows, so --ignore-scripts trades a build failure for a boot-time module-load failure.
Distinguishes acquireLockHandleWin32/named kernel semaphore from POSIX flock with evidence, concludes the fs-ext flock branch is dead on Windows, and keeps real flock on Linux/macOS.

Full plan: platform-gated install script, pure-JS flock shim with callback no-op on Windows only, patch registered in pnpm-workspace.yaml plus allowBuilds, and reinstall/module-load/HTTP-boot verification while POSIX keeps the native addon.
Explicitly respects the no-Visual-Studio owner constraint and uses the repository-managed patch mechanism with no upstream changes.
Cites DSH-0.1.3-A1-03 and connects it to the fs-ext install-channel failure and the Windows pnpm-patch recipe.

caps.reason: Final plan explicitly installs no Visual Studio or Build Tools.
Rejects --ignore-scripts alone; final plan patches the entry so it loads, not just skipping the build.
Uses a repository-local pnpm patch; no upstream repository edit or release is required.
Windows locking stays on the named kernel semaphore; the no-op shim covers only the unused Windows flock path and POSIX keeps real flock.
